issue_request: FHIR-43444 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for OO to analyze DeviceRequest against the workflow Request pattern. The approved changes were to rename DeviceRequest.code to DeviceRequest.product, add workflow mappings from DeviceRequest.doNotPerform to Request.doNotPerform and DeviceRequest.product to Request.product, remove the old DeviceRequest instantiates elements in favor of workflow-instantiates extensions, and leave other Request pattern elements out where there was no use case.
initial_application: Jira records application in commit 24b68f1e49. That commit updated the active DeviceRequest StructureDefinition, examples, and search-parameter bundle by removing DeviceRequest.instantiatesCanonical and DeviceRequest.instantiatesUri, renaming the requested-device element from code to product, and updating product/device search parameter expressions. Later commit ce624b1f85 added a DeviceRequest ballot note documenting those R6 changes without reversing the source semantics.
additional_context: DeviceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini under draft-resources and resources. Current source/devicerequest/structuredefinition-DeviceRequest.xml maps DeviceRequest.doNotPerform to Request.doNotPerform and DeviceRequest.product[x] to Request.product. The mapping-exceptions file records those mappings and leaves Request.code/category/statusReason/reported/performerType/deliverTo unmapped, matching the Jira discussion. Later FHIR-54661 category discussion is unresolved/Triaged and is not a final reversal. A generated-looking devicerequest.svg still contains old anchors, but the authoritative XML and search-parameter sources are correct and SVG-only edits are outside this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative DeviceRequest source already implements the applied Jira decision and no later final decision requires a different DeviceRequest edit for this issue.
